pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Thullanandā bhikkhunī aññatarissā bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattetvā paribhuñjati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.3: atha kho sā bhikkhunī taṃ cīvaraṃ saṃharitvā nikkhipi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.4: Thullanandā bhikkhunī taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.5: yan te ayye mayā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattitaṃ kahan taṃ cīvaran ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.6: atha kho sā bhikkhunī taṃ cīvaraṃ nīharitvā Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā dassesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.7: Thullanandā bhikkhunī taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.8: hand' ayye tuyhaṃ cīvaraṃ, āhara metaṃ cīvaraṃ; yaṃ tuyhaṃ tuyham ev' etaṃ, yaṃ mayhaṃ mayham ev' etaṃ; āhara metaṃ, sakaṃ paccāharā 'ti acchindi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.9: atha kho sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattetvā acchindissatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.12: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ . . . ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.14: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī . . . acchindatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.17: hi nāma bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī . . . acchindissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.20.1: yā pana bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattetvā sā pacchā evaṃ vadeyya: hand' ayye tuyhaṃ cīvaraṃ, āhara metaṃ cīvaraṃ; yaṃ tuyhaṃ tuyham ev' etaṃ, yaṃ mayhaṃ mayham ev' etaṃ; āhara metaṃ, sakaṃ paccāharā 'ti acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.10: parittena vā vipulaṃ vipulena vā parittaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.15: sakiṃ āṇattā bahukam pi acchindati, nissaggiyaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.16: nissajjitabbaṃ saṃghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.19: idaṃ me ayye cīvaraṃ bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ parivattetvā acchinnaṃ nissaggiyaṃ. imāhaṃ saṃghassa nissajjāmīti --pa--
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññā cīvaraṃ parivattetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.4: aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ parivattetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.5: anupasampannāya saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ vā aññaṃ vā parikkhāraṃ parivattetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
